notes: Trajectory spec for the builder agent. Writes to source files outside the build package scope are enforced by the guard's scope lock (build mode), not by this spec: scope varies per story, so no fixed pattern can express it. This spec checks the posture: the package read, the done commands and the writer were called, and no org call, deploy, push, PR approval, promotion, packaging, session start, framework-path write or fetch was allowed. Deploy and push are matched in command position (at the start or after ; & |), so a grep for the word does not count.
